states.revealedCondition: Box scratched because 64 (Europe) was still sealed.
states.revealedText:
Our scouts report that the Hollow Men have raided Europe. We quickly mobilized... but too late.

Open Package 4 and follow the instructions inside. (This does not complete any objectives.)

Destroy the "Relocation" Unrationed Event card inside.

Then, open 21.

mechanics.whenRead: STOP. Draw and read during step 2 of the setup of the first game in June.
triggers: 64 (Europe) has not been opened: scratch the box.
opensDoors: 21, only if the box is scratched, after Package 4
destroys: The "Relocation" Unrationed Event inside Package 4, if the box is scratched.
rules: If 64 is already open, scratch nothing.
If 64 is sealed, open Package 4 and follow the instructions inside.
Opening Package 4 this way does not complete any objectives.
Destroy the Unrationed Event named Relocation that is inside the package.
Destroy this card after resolving it.
mechanics.notes: "Open Package 4", "Destroy the "Relocation" Unrationed Event card inside.", and "Then, open 21." are bold. 64 and 21 are in red boxes. Side A is unchanged in state 2.
